description: In decoding_key_and_alg, an EC JWK with no alg field always falls through to Algorithm::ES256 (the Some("ES256") | None arm). If the JWK contains a P-384 key (crv=P-384) but no alg field, the code uses ES256 to decode a JWT that was signed with ES384 — verification will fail. RFC 7518 §3.1 specifies that the algorithm should be inferred from the curve (P-256→ES256, P-384→ES384). The Jwk struct does not parse the crv field, so curve-based defaulting is impossible without adding crv. Mitigation: add crv to Jwk, default based on curve, or reject EC keys with no alg field rather than blindly defaulting to ES256.
title: oidc: EC JWK defaults to ES256 when alg absent, regardless of curve
